home.greeting: Salom, men O‘zbekistonda yashovchi frontend muhandisman!
home.name: MukhammadBobur
home.workText: MukhammadBobur — hayotni kod, ijodkorlik va qiziqish orqali o‘rganadigan digital nomad. U zamonaviy frontend tajribalarini yaratadi, yangi joylarni kashf qiladi, otalik mas’uliyatini qadrlaydi va professional hamda shaxsiy o‘sishga ilhom beradigan g‘oyalarni doim izlaydi.
home.interests: Qahva, kitoblar va o‘qish, pianino, side-projectlar yaratish, mashina haydash

bio.university: Sejong University (세종대학교) Computer Science and Engineering yo‘nalishi bo‘yicha bakalavr dasturini tamomlagan
bio.startup: Karyerasini Koreyadagi startup kompaniyada Frontend Engineer sifatida boshlagan
bio.fintech: Koreyadagi fintech startup kompaniyada mobil va web ilova ishlab chiqishni boshqargan

gamehub.title: Gamehub
gamehub.description: React, TypeScript va RAWG API integratsiyasi asosida yaratilgan zamonaviy o‘yin qidirish platformasi. Unda trenddagi o‘yinlarni ko‘rish, janr va platformalarni o‘rganish, tezkor qidiruvdan foydalanish hamda qulay adaptiv filtrlash va saralash imkoniyatlari mavjud.

personalBlog.title: Personal Blog
personalBlog.description: HTML, SCSS, JavaScript va Gulp asosida yaratilgan zamonaviy shaxsiy blog platformasi. Unda adaptiv layoutlar, maqola sahifalari, dark mode uslubi va o‘qishga yo‘naltirilgan toza editorial UI mavjud.

characterCounter.title: Character Counter
characterCounter.description: Vanilla JavaScript, HTML, SCSS va Gulp asosida yaratilgan interaktiv belgilar hisoblagichi. U real vaqtda matn tahlili, adaptiv layoutlar va zamonaviy frontend workflow imkoniyatlarini taqdim etadi.

cargoDashboard.title: Cargo Dashboard
cargoDashboard.description: Sarbon Cargo Dashboard — logistika boshqaruvi uchun zamonaviy platforma.

oldPortfolio.title: Portfolio (Old)
oldPortfolio.description: Next.js, TypeScript, Astro-inspired kontent arxitekturasi va Tailwind CSS asosida yaratilgan zamonaviy dasturchi portfolio sayti. Unda adaptiv layoutlar, loyiha ko‘rgazmalari, dark mode qo‘llab-quvvatlashi va performance-focused frontend dizayn mavjud.

mecenateFeeds.title: Mecenate Feeds App
mecenateFeeds.description: React Native, Expo, MobX, React Query va WebSockets asosida yaratilgan real-time social feed ilovasi. Unda infinite scroll, optimistic updates, live interactions va scalable mobile architecture mavjud.
